title: yaml.load() without SafeLoader on file contents in load_quota_profile()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L17 calls yaml.load(handle.read()) without a Loader argument; the default Loader in PyYAML allows arbitrary Python object construction, enabling remote code execution if an attacker can control the YAML file contents.
owaspCategory: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures

title: TLS verification disabled (verify=False) in fetch_project()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L24 calls requests.get with verify=False, disabling TLS certificate validation for the outbound HTTP request; this allows a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept or modify the response.

title: OS command injection via os.system() with caller-supplied command in export_report()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L31 passes the 'command' parameter directly to os.system(); if 'command' is derived from user-controlled input, shell metacharacters can inject arbitrary OS commands.
